name: HEGROUP
recent: HE Group Berhad 近期只有董事 Haw Chee Seng 在闭门期内的连续增持公告，没有其他重大企业活动。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收与净利均较上季及去年同期增长。
notable: 董事 Haw Chee Seng 在2026年11月2日至16日期间多次增持公司股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 46,143,000，净利 MYR 5,104,000，净利率 11.1%；营收环比增长 75.8%，净利环比增长 99.2%，营收同比增长 44.0%，净利同比增长 61.3%。

recent_en: HE Group Berhad recently only had announcements of Managing Director Haw Chee Seng's continuous acquisitions during the closed period, with no other major corporate activities. The latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 saw revenue and net profit grow both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Director Haw Chee Seng acquired shares in the company multiple times between 2 and 16 November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 46,143,000 and net profit was MYR 5,104,000, with a net margin of 11.1%; revenue grew 75.8% QoQ and net profit 99.2% QoQ, while revenue rose 44.0% YoY and net profit 61.3% YoY.
